requested_observation.kind: observation-level escalation on the SAME run (no new sample)
requested_observation.why: level 1 cannot separate waiting from service, cannot attribute work to servers, and cannot see exit reasons. All three are needed to discriminate H1/H2/H4.

established_from_OBS-001.E1_no_abandonment: the 1872 customers without a departure are exactly the last 1872 arrivals (tail purity 1.000)
established_from_OBS-001.E2_capacity_deficit: completion rate 2.4339 < arrival rate 2.7623; backlog grows at exactly the difference 0.3284
established_from_OBS-001.E3_capacity_is_congestion_independent: completion rate is flat (+0.0117 per decile) while the backlog grows from ~0 to ~1870
established_from_OBS-001.E4_batch_arrivals: 49.5% of arrival timestamps are exact ties; epoch process Poisson (ID 0.933, gap CV 0.982); batch size geometric, mean 1.981, var 1.934 vs geometric 1.943
established_from_OBS-001.E5_effective_service: throughput/c = 0.6085 per server under saturation => effective mean service time 1.6435 vs nominal 1.0

competing_hypotheses.H1_heterogeneous_servers: servers have fixed, unequal rates whose sum is 2.434
competing_hypotheses.H2_homogeneous_slow: all servers identical with rate 0.6085; the nominal rate 1.0 is simply wrong
competing_hypotheses.H3_congestion_slowdown: already falsified by E3; retained only as a null to re-check
competing_hypotheses.H4_vacations_or_interruptions: servers are unavailable part of the time even while customers wait

predictions.claim: exit_reason takes only the values 'served' and 'in_system'; zero rows are 'abandoned' or 'balked'.
mean of (departure_time - service_start_time) over served customers is 1.6435, within +/- 0.05.
predictions.falsifies_if_wrong: E5 and the identity throughput = c / E[S] under saturation

predictions.claim: H1 vs H2 decision: per-server completion counts. Under H2 the four counts are equal within Poisson noise (chi-square p > 0.01). Under H1 they are decisively unequal (chi-square p < 1e-6) and max/min server rate > 1.5.
predictions.prior: H1 favoured, because a mean rate of exactly 0.6085 for all four servers would require the stated nominal 1.0 to be wrong by a specific factor with no mechanism
predictions.threshold: the chi-square p-value decides; no other outcome is allowed to be read as support

predictions.claim: server busy fraction under saturation is >= 0.995 for every server, i.e. no server is idle while customers wait.
predictions.falsifies_if_wrong: H4 (vacations / interruptions) becomes the live explanation of the capacity deficit instead of H1/H2
predictions.threshold: any server with busy fraction < 0.99 while n_waiting > 0 falsifies

predictions.claim: per-server service-duration coefficient of variation identifies the service law. I predict CV in [0.9, 1.1] for every server (exponential service), because nothing in OBS-001 requires a non-exponential law.
predictions.note: this is the weakest prediction and the one most likely to fail; OBS-001 carries almost no information about service shape
predictions.threshold: any server CV outside [0.9, 1.1] falsifies the exponential-service assumption

predictions.claim: n_waiting at the end of the qsample series is >= 1500, and n_busy = 4 for more than 99% of samples after t = 1000.
predictions.threshold: either part failing falsifies the saturated-FCFS reading of OBS-001

what_this_cannot_settle: the service-time law at an unsaturated server (all OBS-001/002 service starts happen in a saturated system)
whether server vacations exist at low load (the queue is never empty here)
whether the arrival epoch rate is time-varying on a scale longer than the 5650-unit window
